'''''Manx''''' was a pair of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvettes]] employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were part of a convoy en route to [[Petrakis]] along with sister group [[Hornet (corvette group)|Hornet]], some [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transports]], [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda shuttles]] and two pairs of [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] [[Ocean (freighters)|''Ocean'']] and ''[[Teve]]''. The convoy was to rendezvous with [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], but two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]], escorted by a single [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] arrived to destroy the convoy. The TIE [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who were struck with fear retreated from the attack without engaging the Rebel fighters. The corvettes, along with the rest of the convoy were destroyed by the fighters and they returned to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
